ability.name: Victory Star
ability.note: If this Pokémon is not affected by a special condition, it may MP move over opposing non-Flying-type Pokémon on the field. This Pokémon may respin just once in battles on your turn.

wheel.name: Fusion Bolt
wheel.note: *If this Pokémon is not affected by a special condition, and if any of your other [CTRL QL Fusion Flare][Pokémon] on the field has the Fusion Flare Attack, exclude Pokémon knocked out by this Attack from the duel.

wheel.name: V-Create
wheel.note: *Attaches an MP -1 marker to this Pokémon.

wheel.name: Fusion Flare
wheel.note: *If this Pokémon is not affected by a special condition, and if any of your other [CTRL QL Fusion Bolt][Pokémon] on the field has the Fusion Bolt Attack, exclude Pokémon knocked out by this Attack from the duel.

wheel.name: Searing Shot
wheel.note: The battle opponent and the Pokémon in a straight line directly behind it become burned.
